cards.gloss_en: carry or move something from one place to another
cards.ex_en: The bus can convey forty people at a time.
cards.ex_cn: 这辆公交车一次能运送四十人。

cards.gloss_en: a place where someone lives
cards.ex_en: This little cottage was his only abode.
cards.ex_cn: 这间小屋是他唯一的住所。

cards.gloss_en: the state of being shut in and unable to get out
cards.ex_en: The storm kept us in confinement for three days.
cards.ex_cn: 暴风雨让我们被困了三天。

cards.gloss_en: the act of planting seeds in the ground
cards.ex_en: Spring is the best time for sowing seeds.
cards.ex_cn: 春天是播种的最佳时节。

cards.gloss_en: a part or share of a whole amount
cards.ex_en: Mix the flour and water in equal proportion.
cards.ex_cn: 把面粉和水按相等的比例混合。

cards.gloss_en: rested or lay quietly
cards.ex_en: She reposed on the grass after the long walk.
cards.ex_cn: 长途步行后她躺在草地上休息。

cards.gloss_en: a small rough hut or shelter
cards.ex_en: The rabbit slept in a wooden hutch.
cards.ex_cn: 兔子睡在一个木头窝里。

cards.gloss_en: kind blessings or acts of compassion
cards.ex_en: He thanked God for all his mercies.
cards.ex_cn: 他为所有的恩慈感谢上帝。

cards.gloss_en: lasting forever with no end
cards.ex_en: They believed in eternal life.
cards.ex_cn: 他们相信有永恒的生命。

cards.gloss_en: cut and gathered a ripe crop
cards.ex_en: The farmers reaped the wheat in autumn.
cards.ex_cn: 农民们在秋天收割了小麦。

cards.gloss_en: preserving food by drying, salting, or smoking
cards.ex_en: The curing of the meat took several days.
cards.ex_cn: 这肉的腌制花了好几天。

cards.gloss_en: a substance used to make bread rise
cards.ex_en: You need yeast to make the bread rise.
cards.ex_cn: 你需要酵母才能让面包发起来。

cards.gloss_en: small earthenware cooking pots
cards.ex_en: She cooked the soup in small clay pipkins.
cards.ex_cn: 她用小陶罐煮汤。

cards.gloss_en: cloths worn around the neck
cards.ex_en: The sailors wore neckcloths around their throats.
cards.ex_cn: 水手们在脖子上系着领巾。

cards.gloss_en: the work of farming and managing land
cards.ex_en: Good husbandry made the farm prosper.
cards.ex_cn: 精心的耕作使农场兴旺起来。

cards.gloss_en: the quality of being easy and useful
cards.ex_en: A phone brings great convenience to daily life.
cards.ex_cn: 手机给日常生活带来很大便利。

cards.gloss_en: keen strong wish to do something
cards.ex_en: The boy opened the gift with eagerness.
cards.ex_cn: 男孩急切地打开了礼物。

cards.gloss_en: chopped or cut with heavy blows
cards.ex_en: He hewed the log into planks with an axe.
cards.ex_cn: 他用斧头把原木砍成木板。

cards.gloss_en: supreme power to rule over a place
cards.ex_en: The king held sovereignty over the whole land.
cards.ex_cn: 国王对整片土地拥有统治权。

cards.gloss_en: careful good judgment in what one does
cards.ex_en: He handled the matter with great discretion.
cards.ex_cn: 他很谨慎地处理了这件事。

cards.gloss_en: a flat piece that hangs down to cover an opening
cards.ex_en: A flap of cloth covered the small opening.
cards.ex_cn: 一块布片盖住了那个小口子。

cards.gloss_en: suffering badly from lack of food
cards.ex_en: The starving dog searched for food.
cards.ex_cn: 那只挨饿的狗到处找食物。

cards.gloss_en: came in between or happened in the meantime
cards.ex_en: A teacher intervened to stop the fight.
cards.ex_cn: 一位老师介入制止了这场打斗。

cards.gloss_en: noticing or becoming aware of something
cards.ex_en: Perceiving the danger, she stepped back.
cards.ex_cn: 察觉到危险,她退了回去。

cards.gloss_en: great tiredness from effort
cards.ex_en: After the race he felt great fatigue.
cards.ex_cn: 比赛后他感到十分疲劳。

cards.gloss_en: a fast light warship
cards.ex_en: A frigate guarded the harbour at night.
cards.ex_cn: 一艘护卫舰在夜里守卫港口。

cards.gloss_en: traps for catching birds or animals
cards.ex_en: The hunter set snares to catch rabbits.
cards.ex_cn: 猎人设下陷阱来捕兔子。

cards.gloss_en: settlements ruled by a distant country
cards.ex_en: The country once had many colonies overseas.
cards.ex_cn: 这个国家曾在海外拥有许多殖民地。

cards.gloss_en: properly and at the right time
cards.ex_en: The letter was duly delivered on Monday.
cards.ex_cn: 这封信在周一如期送到。

cards.gloss_en: next to and touching something
cards.ex_en: They stayed in two adjoining rooms.
cards.ex_cn: 他们住在两间相邻的房间里。

cards.gloss_en: highest in power, rank, or degree
cards.ex_en: The court made the supreme decision.
cards.ex_cn: 法院作出了最高的裁决。

cards.gloss_en: anger at something unfair or wrong
cards.ex_en: She spoke with indignation about the unfair rule.
cards.ex_cn: 她愤慨地谈起那条不公平的规定。

cards.gloss_en: deep careful thoughts
cards.ex_en: His cogitations kept him awake all night.
cards.ex_cn: 他的沉思让他整夜未眠。

cards.gloss_en: impossible to travel through or across
cards.ex_en: The flooded road was impassable.
cards.ex_cn: 被水淹的道路无法通行。

cards.gloss_en: a group of large animals kept together
cards.ex_en: A herd of cows crossed the field.
cards.ex_cn: 一群牛穿过田野。

cards.gloss_en: the bones of the head
cards.ex_en: The cave floor was covered with old skulls.
cards.ex_cn: 洞穴地面上满是旧头骨。

cards.gloss_en: eating hungrily and greedily
cards.ex_en: The lion was devouring its prey.
cards.ex_cn: 狮子正在吞食它的猎物。

cards.gloss_en: shockingly cruel or terrible
cards.ex_en: Their outrageous behaviour shocked everyone.
cards.ex_cn: 他们骇人的行为让所有人震惊。

cards.gloss_en: a person who puts condemned people to death
cards.ex_en: The executioner stood beside the block.
cards.ex_cn: 刽子手站在断头台旁。

cards.gloss_en: wild uncivilized people
cards.ex_en: The city was attacked by fierce barbarians.
cards.ex_cn: 这座城市遭到凶猛野蛮人的进攻。

cards.gloss_en: clever plans or secret plots
cards.ex_en: He made many schemes to escape the island.
cards.ex_cn: 他想出许多逃离小岛的计划。

skipped: frog(太基础·书中特殊义太生僻)

suspect.ctx: surveying it... to think that this was all my own... and if I could convey it, I might have it in inheritance
suspect.issue: 书中 convey 用于产权/所有权语境("若我能 convey 它,便可传为遗产"),是法律上的"转让、让渡(财产)"义;现释义"运送、传达"回读不通,既非搬运也非传话。
suspect.suggest: 增补一条义项"(法律上)转让、让与(财产)",例句配产权转移场景。

suspect.ctx: had the least cloudy or hazy weather intervened, I had been undone another way
suspect.issue: 书中 intervene 主语是"天气",意为"(其间)横生、出现于中途";现释义首义"介入"强烈暗示"人主动出面干预",易误导,虽"插进"勉强能覆盖但非自然读法。
suspect.suggest: 调整为"(某情况)出现于其间、横生其中"为主义,"介入"退为次义。
